questions.question: God said the people of Judah had wearied Him with their words. What had they been saying?

answers.text: Evildoers are good in His sight
The prophets don't speak for Him

questions.question: The LORD of Hosts promised to send His messenger. What would the messenger do?

answers.text: Guard the doors of His temple

questions.question: God asked who could stand when the Lord He promised comes to His temple. What will that Lord be like?

answers.text: Like a shaking of earth and sky

questions.question: The LORD said He would be a swift witness against sorcerers and adulterers. Who else is on His list?

answers.text: Those who cheat workers of their wages
Those who skip the yearly feasts
Those who eat food that is unclean
